data.value:
The Output, Error List, and Command Window:
1. Output Window - displays status messages for various features in the Integrated Development Environment (IDE). To view the Output Window, on the menu bar, click View, and find Output (or click CTRL + ALT + O).
2. Error List Window - displays information about a specific error message. You can copy the error number or error string text from the Output window.
3. Command Window - used to execute commands or aliases directly in the Visual Studio's IDE. You can execute both menu commands and commands that do not appear on any menu. To display this window, on the menu bar, click View, find Other Windows, and click Command Window.

data.name: RichTextBox2.Text
data.value:
Form Designer Window
Allows you to design your application's user interface visually by dragging controls onto a design-time representation of your application. Once the controls are on the form, you can visually position the controls, set their properties through the Properties Window, and create events handlers for the events.

data.name: RichTextBox3.Text
data.value:
Properties Window
Shows all the control properties to be changed at design time. Most of these properties can also be changed with code at run time, but basically most properties change the way the control is displayed on your application.

data.name: RichTextBox4.Text
data.value:
Solution Explorer Window
A section that is used to view and modify the contents of the project. A Visual Studio Windows Application Project will generally have a Form object with code page, references to System components and possibly other modules with special code that is used by the application.

data.name: RichTextBox5.Text
data.value:
Toolbox Window
A window for selecting controls to use in an application's user interface.
It is divided intro several sections: - All Windows Forms - Common Controls - Containers - Menus & Toolbars - Data - Components - Printing - Dialogs - General
